description.value: OPUS Vancouver is a 96-room boutique luxury hotel in Yaletown, recognized by Condé Nast Traveler (Top Hotel in Western Canada 2025) and Forbes Travel Guide. The property features on-site Italian dining at Capo and a cocktail bar (The Spritz), along with spa bathrooms, digital check-in, and dog-friendly policies. A touring cyclist overnighting here would find an upscale urban base steps from Vancouver's restaurant and shopping district, though no cycling-specific services are advertised.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 49m; stands (3 spaces) at 52m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 73m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms OSM contact details (address, phone, email all match). No cycling-specific amenities — bike storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging — are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; both required criteria must be null. Wi-Fi is confirmed true by both the OSM tag (internet_access=wlan, fee=no) and the website homepage listing it as a feature. On-site evening dining at Capo restaurant is confirmed by the website, satisfying Nearby evening food.
concerns: Neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from website content — direct verification with the property is needed before listing.
OSM name is 'Opus' but hotel markets itself as 'OPUS Vancouver'; no material discrepancy but worth noting for display consistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, operating hotel in Vancouver's Yaletown, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure is mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags — both WWC required criteria are unconfirmed. Needs direct outreach to determine if cycling guests can be accommodated.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Capo restaurant serves Italian lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch; The Spritz cocktail bar also on-site
